gloss_en: Masa u'matan — business dealings / commerce, the worldly activity of buying, selling, and trade (Zevulun's 'going out'), which Rabbi Nachman homiletically re-reads as 'carrying and giving' (lifting fallen sparks and returning them, the union of tzaddik and Knesset Yisrael); not physical burden-carrying or a prophetic 'massa' (oracle)
